comment: QUESTS.md A10, NIX-5 Half An Encounter. Encounters are left on. The mouth without Nix is unchanged; with Nix and the wood cleared, Enoch Bagshawe and his reed, one blush. Night one: in at night with the battle count stored, and back out of the south end, abandoned. Night two: a forced battle, and the parallel reed event fails it the moment the battle ends. Night three: through to the north exit - the far-end check passes, the fee, one trope, Nix's story. Afterwards the mouth is the mouth. P1: Bagshawe mentions the mothballs both nights; night three uses one as the menu does, has a second given back while it works, walks four steps on an encounter count of one without a fight, and watches it wear off. Then the airing: refused at 74 steps after, taken at 75.

steps.comment: Encounters stay on: this is the one scenario that wants them.
